records.jp: 私があの後、リフレクターになるまでの話……<CR>順を追って説明する必要があると思う
records.en_original: About how I became a Reflector... I think I should explain things in order.
records.en: About how I became a Reflector... I think I should explain things in order.

records.jp: 勇希と離れ離れになっちゃって……<CR>その後の話ってことだよね？
records.en_original: You mean what happened after you were separated from Yuki?
records.en: You mean what happened after you were separated from Yuki?

records.jp: うん。私は……勇希の居場所と灰病について調べ始めた
records.en_original: Yes... I looked into the facility where Yuki was checked in to, and about Ash Syndrome itself.
records.en: Yes... I looked into the facility where Yuki was checked in to, and about Ash Syndrome itself.

records.jp: 春日さんも言ってたけど、灰病は灰が降り始めてから<CR>確認された新しい病気で……不治の病だった
records.en_original: As Kasuga said, it was a new disease that emerged after the Ash started falling. It had no cure.
records.en: As Kasuga-san said, it was a new disease that emerged after the Ash started falling. It had no cure.

records.jp: だから灰病を専門で扱っている施設も<CR>限定的であることが分かったの
records.en_original: Because of this, only a small number of facilities specialized in Ash Syndrome.
records.en: Because of this, only a small number of facilities specialized in Ash Syndrome.

records.jp: そうして調べていくうちに、灰病を扱っている施設は<CR>いずれもとある機関の傘下にあることがわかった
records.en_original: As I looked more into it, I discovered that the facilities were all affiliated with one organization.
records.en: As I looked more into it, I discovered that the facilities were all affiliated with one organization.

records.jp: 勇希に会うには、その機関から情報を得るしかない……
records.en_original: The only way I was going to see Yuki again was to get information from that organization...
records.en: The only way I was going to see Yuki again was to get information from that organization...

records.jp: そう思って、私はその機関が出している<CR>アルバイトの求人に応募した
records.en_original: To that end, I decided to apply for a part-time job there.
records.en: To that end, I decided to apply for a part-time job there.

records.jp: そしたらなぜか、検査を受けることになって……。<CR>私にリフレクターの適性があることが分かった
records.en_original: For some reason, they had me take a test, and...I discovered I had the aptitude to be a Reflector.
records.en: For some reason, they had me take a test, and...I discovered I had the aptitude to be a Reflector.

records.jp: そして、この指輪を渡されたの。<CR>これで人々の想いを守ってほしいって言われて
records.en_original: Then they gave me this ring. They told me that they wanted me to use it to guard people's emotions.
records.en: Then they gave me this ring. They told me that they wanted me to use it to guard people's emotions.

records.jp: 想いを、守る……？
records.en_original: Guard people's emotions...?
records.en: Guard people's emotions...?

records.jp: 私もわけがわからなかった。<CR>けど、機関に入るにはその仕事を引き受けるしかない
records.en_original: I didn't understand either. But to join the organization, I had to accept.
records.en: I didn't understand either. But to join the organization, I had to accept.

records.jp: だから言ったの。やりますって
records.en_original: So I told them I would do it.
records.en: So I told them I would do it.

records.jp: そうして私はリフレクターになった
records.en_original: And I became a Reflector.
records.en: And I became a Reflector.

records.jp: 結果的にその選択は正解だった
records.en_original: It turned out to be the right choice.
records.en: It turned out to be the right choice.

records.jp: リフレクターには特権が与えられていて、<CR>機関の持ってる情報をいろいろ知ることができたから
records.en_original: I was given special privileges as a Reflector, and I learned plenty from the organization.
records.en: I was given special privileges as a Reflector, and I learned plenty from the organization.

records.jp: そして、その機関は灰について研究を行っていた
records.en_original: As it turned out, the organization was conducting research on the Ash.
records.en: As it turned out, the organization was conducting research on the Ash.

records.jp: 灰を研究する機関……！
records.en_original: An organization researching the Ash...!
records.en: An organization researching the Ash...!

records.jp: そう……その名も、AASA
records.en_original: That's right... It was called AASA.
records.en: That's right... It was called AASA.

records.jp: そうだ、わたしも……<CR>わたしも、AASAに所属していたのです
records.en_original: That's right... I belonged to AASA as well.
records.en: That's right... I belonged to AASA as well.

records.jp: こ、こころも！？
records.en_original: You, too?!
records.en: You, too?!

records.jp: 私は靭さんとは面識はなかったけど、<CR>多くのリフレクターはAASAに所属してたと思う
records.en_original: I didn't know Utsubo, but there were many Reflectors that belonged to AASA.
records.en: I didn't know Utsubo-san, but there were many Reflectors that belonged to AASA.

records.jp: 金城さんについては何かわかったんですか？
records.en_original: Did you learn anything about Yuki?
records.en: Did you learn anything about Kinjou-san?

records.jp: ううん。<CR>さすがに、個人情報の閲覧許可は下りなかったから
records.en_original: No. I was never granted permission to view files with personal information.
records.en: No. I was never granted permission to view files with personal information.

records.jp: でも、たまに目を盗んで資料を漁ってた。<CR>たぶん、最後まで見つけられなかったんだろうけど……
records.en_original: I'd occasionally see what I could find while no one was watching, but I believe I didn't find anything of use.
records.en: I'd occasionally see what I could find while no one was watching, but I believe I didn't find anything of use.

records.jp: 灰については何かわかったの？
records.en_original: Did you find anything out about the Ash?
records.en: Did you find anything out about the Ash?

records.jp: 灰は、体内を巡る活力、生命力の流れを<CR>著しく阻害するエネルギーを持った物質なの
records.en_original: The Ash is a substance which carries energy. This energy greatly inhibits the flow of one's life force and vitality.
records.en: The Ash is a substance which carries energy. This energy greatly inhibits the flow of one's life force and vitality.

records.jp: 人間がそれを吸い込むと、発熱や咳に始まり、<CR>重症になると体内組織すら破壊される。それが灰病
records.en_original: When a person inhales the Ash, they soon develop a fever and cough. The symptoms progress until the patient's organs fail. That is Ash Syndrome.
records.en: When a person inhales the Ash, they soon develop a fever and cough. The symptoms progress until the patient's organs fail. That is Ash Syndrome.

records.jp: 突如として世界中に降り始めた灰は、<CR>出所も分からなければ、科学的説明もつかない
records.en_original: Currently, there is no scientific explanation for the origin of the Ash that suddenly began falling worldwide.
records.en: Currently, there is no scientific explanation for the origin of the Ash that suddenly began falling worldwide.

records.jp: 神様が世界を終わらせようとしている……<CR>そんな終末論で、世界中が大パニックになった
records.en_original: There are theories that God itself is trying to end the world. Such talk sparked a global panic.
records.en: There are theories that God itself is trying to end the world. Such talk sparked a global panic.

records.jp: ――ごめん。私が思い出せたのは、それくらい
records.en_original: I'm sorry. That's everything that I can remember.
records.en: I'm sorry. That's everything that I can remember.

records.jp: い、いや！　すごいよ！<CR>外のこと、だいぶ分かってきた……！
records.en_original: No, this is fantastic! Now we have a better idea of what's going on outside!
records.en: No, this is fantastic! Now we have a better idea of what's going on outside!

records.jp: でも、外がそんな状況だったなんて……
records.en_original: To think that the situation out there was that awful...
records.en: To think that the situation out there was that awful...

records.jp: 今はどうなってるんだろう……
records.en_original: I wonder what it's like now...
records.en: I wonder what it's like now...

records.jp: あ、あの
records.en_original: U-um...
records.en: U-um...

records.jp: ずっと気になってることがあるんですけど、<CR>聞いてもいいですか？
records.en_original: Can I ask something? I've been wondering about this for a while...
records.en: Can I ask something? I've been wondering about this for a while...

records.jp: 詩帆さん？　うん、教えて
records.en_original: Shiho? Of course, what is it?
records.en: Shiho-san? Of course, what is it?

records.jp: 金城さんのことです
records.en_original: It's about Yuki.
records.en: It's about Kinjou-san.

records.jp: 灰病は、不治の病だったはずですよね
records.en_original: Ash Syndrome has no cure, right?
records.en: Ash Syndrome has no cure, right?

records.jp: でも、ここにいる金城さんは元気いっぱいです。<CR>発熱や咳の様子もない
records.en_original: But Yuki seems just fine. No fever or cough.
records.en: But Kinjou-san seems just fine. No fever or cough.

records.jp: それってつまり――<CR>治す方法が見つかったってことなんじゃないですか？
records.en_original: Wouldn't that mean that a cure has been found?
records.en: Wouldn't that mean that a cure has been found?

records.jp: AASAが灰病の治療法を見つけて、<CR>その結果勇希は治った。そういうことね？
records.en_original: You mean that the AASA found a cure for Ash Syndrome and cured Yuki, yes?
records.en: You mean that the AASA found a cure for Ash Syndrome and cured Yuki, yes?

records.jp: はい
records.en_original: Yes.
records.en: Yes.

records.jp: 宮内さんが金城さんと再会できたかどうかは、<CR>まだ分かりませんが……
records.en_original: Though we still don't know if Miyauchi was ever able to see Yuki again...
records.en: Though we still don't know if Miyauchi-san was ever able to see Kinjou-san again...

records.jp: 少なくとも、今ここにいる金城さんが<CR>健康体なのは、まぎれもない事実ですよね？
records.en_original: At the very least, the Yuki here is healthy. That's a fact, isn't it?
records.en: At the very least, the Kinjou-san here is healthy. That's a fact, isn't it?

records.jp: ……たしかに、そうかもしれない！！
records.en_original: True... You may be right!
records.en: True... You may be right!

records.jp: だとすれば、外の世界にもまだ灰に対する<CR>対抗策があるってことになる！
records.en_original: In that case, that means there's some kind of strategy to deal with the Ash!
records.en: In that case, that means there's some kind of strategy to deal with the Ash!

records.jp: でも、そしたらどうしてわたしたち、<CR>シェルターに入ることになったんだろう？
records.en_original: If that's true, then why did we have to take shelter?
records.en: If that's true, then why did we have to take shelter?

records.jp: たしかに……。<CR>対抗策があるなら避難する必要はないですよね……
records.en_original: That's right. If there had been a cure, there would be no need...
records.en: That's right. If there had been a cure, there would be no need...

records.jp: 灰以外の脅威があったってこと？
records.en_original: Was there some kind of threat other than the Ash?
records.en: Was there some kind of threat other than the Ash?

records.jp: 灰病は治せても、灰が生み出した怪物は<CR>倒せなかった……そういうことなのかな
records.en_original: Maybe they found a cure for Ash Syndrome, but couldn't take down all the monsters created by the Ash or something.
records.en: Maybe they found a cure for Ash Syndrome, but couldn't take down all the monsters created by the Ash or something.

records.jp: あの、クラックから現れた怪物か……！
records.en_original: Like the one that came out of the Crack!
records.en: Like the one that came out of the Crack!

records.jp: ……すいません、ぬか喜びさせてしまいました
records.en_original: I'm sorry, I may have celebrated a bit too soon...
records.en: I'm sorry, I may have celebrated a bit too soon...

records.jp: とはいえ、AASAはこの世界の真実に<CR>近いところにいたはず
records.en_original: Still, I believe that AASA was getting close to the truth about this world.
records.en: Still, I believe that AASA was getting close to the truth about this world.

records.jp: AASAがリフレクターを探していて……そして、<CR>今ここに集まっているのもリフレクターなんだから
records.en_original: AASA was looking for Reflectors...and here are a group of Reflectors gathered together.
records.en: AASA was looking for Reflectors...and here are a group of Reflectors gathered together.

records.jp: なるほど……じゃあ、この調子で他のリフレクターや<CR>記憶を集めていけば――
records.en_original: I see... Then, at this rate, as long as we get the other Reflectors' memories back...
records.en: I see... Then, at this rate, as long as we get the other Reflectors' memories back...

records.jp: いずれAASAに……そして、この世界の真実に<CR>たどり着けるかもしれない
records.en_original: We may find AASA, and the truth about this world.
records.en: We may find AASA, and the truth about this world.

records.en_original: (...Yeah.)
records.en: (...Yeah.)

records.jp: （ようやく、道が見えてきたかもしれない……！）
records.en_original: (We're finally starting to see some progress...!)
records.en: (We're finally starting to see some progress...!)
